links.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: «شيخنا» opens the chain as the compiler's own shaykh; «وحدثنا به» is his transmission
Abd al-Rahim al-Qasir asks by letter, so he is a link and the Imam written to closes the chain (owner ruling 2)
«على يدي عبد الملك بن أعين» names the courier of the letter, not a transmitter: left out
The saying is the Imam's written answer; «قال مصنف هذا الكتاب» is the compiler's own gloss

levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: «أخرجه شيخنا ... وحدثنا به» : Ibn al-Walid narrates it to the compiler; the honorifics and «شيخنا» are left out
«كتبت على يدي عبد الملك بن أعين إلى أبي عبد الله» : the writer (Abd al-Rahim) is a link; «على يدي» names the carrier, not a transmitter
the Imam's written answer is the saying; he is the last link, after the writer (ruling 2, rule 5)
